name: Villány (Hungary)
description: White field with two narrow vertical stripes of blue and green at the fly edge, charged at the centre of the white with the town arms of Villány (a shield of blue and yellow with a bunch of grapes and a pruning knife, with a helm, green and blue mantling and a scroll inscribed VILLÁNY).
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Villány arms with helm, mantling and scroll
